title: STAGE: Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion for Weakly Supervised Cross-Tweet Event Causality Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.26255v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal relations in disaster-related social media of- ten span independent posts, making cross-tweet causal discovery difficult to supervise and model at scale. We propose STAGE, a framework that separates scalable cross-tweet weak-supervision construction from spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences. Starting from local causal seeds, STAGE retrieves semantically related event occurrences across tweets and uses a causal scorer to construct weakly labeled cross-tweet pairs. These pairs supervise a multi-head Graph Attention Network over semantically enriched event representations and a spatio- temporal context graph. We evaluate STAGE on California Wildfire and Hurricane Harvey using human-gold cross-tweet test sets and 15 baselines. Compared with local-only supervision, the constructed cross-tweet supervision improves STAGE AUPRC by 0.340 on Wildfire and 0.107 on Hurricane. STAGE achieves in-domain AUROC of 0.885 on

translated_title: STAGE：用于弱监督跨推文事件因果关系发现的时空增强图扩展
translated_abstract: 灾害相关社交媒体中的因果关系往往跨越独立发布的帖子，这使得跨推文因果关系发现难以进行大规模的监督和建模。我们提出STAGE，一个将可扩展的跨推文弱监督构建与基于事件发生的时空关系学习相分离的框架。从局部因果种子出发，STAGE检索跨推文中语义相关的事件发生，并使用因果评分器构建弱标注的跨推文事件对。这些事件对用于监督多头图注意力网络，该网络构建于语义丰富的事件表示和时空上下文图之上。我们使用人工标注的黄金跨推文测试集和15个基线方法，在加州野火和飓风哈维数据集上评估STAGE。与仅使用局部监督相比，构建的跨推文监督使STAGE的AUPRC在野火数据上提升了0.340，在飓风数据上提升了0.107。STAGE在域内测试中取得了0.885的AUROC
tldr: STAGE框架从局部因果种子出发构建跨推文弱监督标签，结合时空上下文图与图注意力网络，实现灾害社交媒体中跨推文事件因果关系的可扩展自动发现，相比局部监督显著提升因果发现性能。
en_tdlr: STAGE constructs scalable weakly supervised cross-tweet labels from local causal seeds and leverages spatio-temporal context graphs with graph attention networks to discover cross-tweet event causal relations in disaster-related social media, substantially improving performance over local-only supervision.
